title: Lotus Creek Exploration Inc. Announces Stock Option Grant
body: Calgary, Alberta–(Newsfile Corp. – July 14, 2026) – Lotus Creek Exploration Inc. (TSXV: LTC) (“Lotus Creek” or the “Company”) announces that pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Company’s stock option plan, the Lotus Creek Board of Directors has approved the grant of 137,700 stock options to certain Directors and Officers.
